name: TESSA V3.2 Mechanical Topology Court V1
research_question: Does motion-conditioned/mechanical topology learning produce meshes that animate more reliably than static/compact topology learning or deterministic field extraction at comparable geometry fidelity?
hypothesis: Mechanical topology evidence will improve deformation stability and reduce motion-induced topology failures relative to static compactness objectives; compactness should be a late selection criterion, not a proxy for animation suitability.
